charts.title: LHS 1140 c: orbits around LHS 1140
charts.description: The orbits of LHS 1140's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LHS 1140 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Cadieux et al. 2024 (2024ApJ...960L...3C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CADIEUX_ET_AL__2024): P 3.77794 d

charts.title: LHS 1140 c: its transit
charts.description: LHS 1140 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (3, 30) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 92226327, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
